title: Diver calls it the most important dive of his life

tellings.quote: >> That was probably the most important dive I've ever done in my life. I've done maybe 6,000 dives in my life.

plain: A diver named Stefan Hogeborn says his 2012 dive to the Baltic Sea anomaly, a strange shape on the floor of the Baltic that the episode calls a UFO on the seafloor, was "probably the most important dive I've ever done in my life." Hogeborn, who made the dive himself, says on the show that he has done about 6,000 dives in all.
